dataset_spec.name: berlin_appendicitis
dataset_spec.description: Berlin paediatric suspected appendicitis (590 children). Binary histopathology from blood counts, CRP, and ultrasound diameter.
dataset_spec.setting: Paediatric emergency evaluation for suspected appendicitis. The prediction uses age, sex, inflammatory blood counts, C-reactive protein, and ultrasound appendiceal diameter available before histopathology.
dataset_spec.observations_header: Blood counts, CRP, and ultrasound findings:

appendicitis.question: Based on the blood counts, CRP, and ultrasound findings, is appendicitis present on histopathology?
